summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten firm-commitment common stock offering. No special-situation transformation is present; this is a routine capital markets transaction. The filing discloses an at-the-market offering of shares at $19.35 per share with over-allotment options, but does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or liquidation. As such, this filing does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
